name: AKTOR Group
note: AKTOR Anonymi Etaireia Symmetochon, Technikon kai Energeiakon Ergon (AKTOR Group), traded on Euronext Athens. Euronext Athens lists three holders of 5% or more of the voting rights: Winex Investments Limited, a legal entity related to chairman and CEO Alexandros Exarchou (33.41%), Castellano Properties Limited of the Gotsis family (20.31%) and Blue Silk (CY) Ltd of Konstantinos Angelou (11.33%), after the July 2026 capital increase.
